title: Three walks that fail on main pass again
goal: Two scripted checks of the video editor fail on the current code for reasons in the checks themselves, so they no longer prove anything: one looks for a menu under its old name, the other presses Undo while the app is in the background where the menu bar is frozen.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-30 on unchanged HEAD 26b43510 in a clean worktree (git worktree add /tmp/photonz-head HEAD; Scripts/playtest.sh <walk> --no-build): every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk: step 66 (panelMenu) FAILED: no menu called "Easing" is in the window; the ones that are: ... Curve (Linear) 153.0pt wide ... every-caption-control-changes-the-captions-walk: step 87 (key) FAILED: command+z is Edit > Undo, which is dimmed and empty in a walk, and nothing else took the press. menu-checkmarks-walk and panel-name-walk got front: true for the same frozen-menu reason on 2026-09-30 (902f8163). Found by the segmented-control task running its segment walks; not caused by it (same failures on HEAD).
acceptance: every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk passes at Next defaults, naming the Curve menu the panel now shows
every-caption-control-changes-the-captions-walk passes, its Undo reaching the app (front: true, or an app-level undo)
library-import-walk passes: importing b-roll.mp4 shows its pill under the canvas
All three pass twice in a row

log.note: also library-import-walk, same day, fails identically on unchanged HEAD 26b43510 and on the segmented-control change: step 10 (expectNotice) FAILED: no pill is up under the canvas, so it cannot be saying "b-roll.mp4 is in the Library" (run alone twice, no system alert in front).

Triage 2026-10-01: all three now pass on main with no change to their scripts. every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk and every-caption-control-changes-the-captions-walk passed in the rotating check at 2026-10-01T02:54Z and again in the full sweep of 2026-10-01 (15:28Z to 18:25Z, 700 of 702 passed, queue/sweep/latest.json); library-import-walk passed in that sweep. The failures on 2026-09-30 were seen in a clean worktree at 26b43510; the app moved on since (the Easing menu the walk names is drawn by the timeline dock). Closing on the sweep's evidence; if any of the three goes red again it lands on the standing walk task.
